阳台的一天(A Day at the balcony): 围绕家庭生活的A1短文:介绍欧文的日常、喜好与阳台。
After school, we play together. We talk about science a lot. Owen wants to visit London. What's more, my aunt sent me a box of tea from Japan.
My friend Amy is very kind. Owen goes to the library on Friday. Amy often helps me with science. Best of all, my aunt is married with two children.
The balcony is not far from my home. The family chat is big and clean. Amy likes bread too.
